description: Read what the learner did on a panel or a pane since you last looked, before you answer them. Call it at the learner's first message after such acts, instead of showing the scene again. After play_in_forms, use the brief in its return instead. Returns {brief: {session_id, cursor, status_line, where{lesson_title, step{index, total}, scene{id, type, title}, waiting}, since_last[{scene_id, act: read | answer | hint | self_rating | contest, lane: fast | companion, correct?, confidence?}], since_last_count, help{rungs}, rules[3]}}. since_last holds the twelve latest acts; since_last_count counts them all. Reading it moves the cursor: the next call lists what came after. It holds no scene text and no key, hint or reference; follow its rules.

peek.description: Read without moving the cursor. For a panel that keeps the model's context up to date; an assistant omits it.

name: get_companion_brief
